scope: Readable Markdown snapshot of loaded conversation content only. Portable attachment bundle and full Agent-history export remain outside this increment.
changes: Agent media-only replies and user/Agent/tool attachment descriptors remain in the export. Binary and embedded resource bodies are not copied.
All reported tool locations (including line numbers), diff paths and declared links/attachment sources are included; exported locations are explicitly unverified.
Pending, in-progress, failed and unknown tools no longer use successful-operation summaries. Completed tools retain the existing summary with explicit status.
Loaded-only scope and streaming snapshot boundaries travel in the Markdown file; later events cannot alter the already serialized string. Message indentation is retained.
Metadata is escaped as text. HTTP(S)/file URL credentials, query and fragment are omitted; unsupported or embedded URI payloads are not exported.

A new save attempt clears the current success receipt. Cancellation is distinct; rejection is unconfirmed and asks the user to inspect the destination before deciding whether to retry. No automatic repeat writes.
privacyBoundary: No rawInput/rawOutput/tool title/text/diff body/terminal body/raw event/thought export.
Ordinary user/Agent message text remains unchanged, including any private information the user put in that visible text; the dialog explicitly asks the user to review it.
Declared names, types and paths are metadata, not proof files exist or were created. URL path components and ordinary local paths are retained and may contain personal information.
No file/URL fetch, history load, new persistent transcript or Agent operation. No service credentials or account configuration are read.
